title: Kelly Boesch Official Music AI Video - Salt On The Tide - 4K
description:
I was playing around in Midjourney with some images with an island feel. I love the dreamy feeling and the flamingos. There are some funny flamingo people which make me laugh. I love these things about ai that make the clips so different from anything else. The song is called 'Salt On The Tide'. I wanted the song to also have a soft island feel. Something calm and warm. Maybe I just need a tropical vacation :-) 

Lyrics written by me, Kelly Boesch. Music created under my creative direction with assistance from Suno.

#ai #aiart #aivideo #music #dance
